notes.title: 10.31 Update
notes.notes:
Added a full unlock button in the main interface of the game (wait 5 seconds to load the first time you open the icon).

Fixed some missing characters.

Added hints for archiving.

Increase the number of archives to 80.

notes.title: Updated on October 30
notes.notes:
Fixed a BUG where steam achievements would not trigger properly.

Do not use the demo archive files to start the official version of the game, it will cause the archive is incompatible and will cause the story nodes such as the wooden man in Chapter 2 to get stuck. Or go back to Brig 2 and cut out the sarcoma and get the weapon.
